data.text: Good morning. How can I track my order?
data.english_gloss: Good morning. How can I track my order?

data.text: Ẹ káàárọ̀, ẹ jọ̀ọ́ ẹ ràn mí lọ́wọ́.
data.english_gloss: Good morning, please help me.

data.text: My money was deducted but I did not receive a receipt.
data.english_gloss: My money was deducted but I did not receive a receipt.

data.text: Owó ti jáde ní àkáǹtì mi, ṣùgbọ́n mi ò rí ìwé-ẹ̀rí ìsanwó.
data.english_gloss: Money was deducted from my account, but I did not receive a payment receipt.

data.text: Ẹ jọ̀ọ́, ẹ dá owó mi padà.
data.english_gloss: Please refund my money.

data.text: Please cancel my order before it ships.
data.english_gloss: Please cancel my order before it ships.

data.text: Mo fẹ́ fagilé order mi.
data.english_gloss: I want to cancel my order.

data.text: Mi ò lè wọlé sí àkáǹtì mi.
data.english_gloss: I cannot log in to my account.

data.text: This app kò ṣiṣẹ́ on my phone.
data.english_gloss: This app does not work on my phone.

data.text: Does this phone come with a warranty?
data.english_gloss: Does this phone come with a warranty?

data.text: Ẹ ṣé gan-an fún ìrànlọ́wọ́ yín.
data.english_gloss: Thank you very much for your help.

data.text: Your support team solved my problem quickly. Thank you!
data.english_gloss: Your support team solved my problem quickly. Thank you!

data.text: Ẹ kò tíì fi ọjà náà ránṣẹ́.
data.english_gloss: You have not sent the item yet.

data.text: Abeg, ẹ check order mi.
data.english_gloss: Please check my order.

data.text: How much does delivery cost?
data.english_gloss: How much does delivery cost?

data.text: Ọjà yìí wù mí gan-an!
data.english_gloss: I really like this product!

data.text: I like the product, but delivery was too slow.
data.english_gloss: I like the product, but delivery was too slow.

data.text: Ẹ ṣe iṣẹ́ yín dáadáa, ṣùgbọ́n delivery pẹ́ jù.
data.english_gloss: You did your work well, but delivery was too late.

data.text: I am unhappy with how my complaint was handled.
data.english_gloss: I am unhappy with how my complaint was handled.

data.text: Ẹ jọ̀ọ́, ẹ sọ fún mi nípa iṣẹ́ yín.
data.english_gloss: Please tell me about your service.
